summary: MPCA Squad Selection Sprint · Iteration A · fully validated. Backend (5/5 pytest) + Frontend (16 UI assertions) all PASS after fixing a MPCA-141 notification schema bug. Verified MPCA-125/154 (single Squads entry point on TournamentDetail), MPCA-131 (Approved-lock backend 409 + UI hides +Pick/+Cap/X, MPCA still can edit Awaiting/Rejected/Draft), MPCA-130 (Finalize XV gone), MPCA-106 (only 4 support-staff slots), MPCA-126 (SquadDetail renders with legacy players), MPCA-141 (secretary + president notifications on approve & reject).

critical.issue: Notification.kind Literal was ['claim_event','sla_breach','info'] — did NOT include 'squad_review'. Also severity Literal was ['info','warning','critical'] — did NOT include 'success'. review_squad_by_mpca passed kind='squad_review' and severity='success' on approve, both failing Pydantic validation. The exception was swallowed by the surrounding try/except, so notifications were NEVER inserted for approve OR reject. Fixed by widening both Literals in /app/backend/models.py (Notification model).

action_items: Main agent: confirm the models.py widening (Notification.kind += 'squad_review', severity += 'success') is acceptable. Alternative would be to drop 'success' from the review handler and use kind='info' — but the current change matches the intent described in MPCA-141 (kind='squad_review') so is preferred.
Consider replacing the bare `except Exception: pass` in review_squad_by_mpca with logging so future schema-mismatch bugs surface early instead of silently dropping notifications.
critical_code_review_comments: selection_console.py review_squad_by_mpca wraps notification creation in a bare try/except pass — this masked the Pydantic validation failure and made MPCA-141 look 'silently broken' in production. Add structured logging.

SquadDetail.jsx `canEdit` correctly implements MPCA-131 lock. The isMine-vs-isMPCA logic is subtle — consider a comment explaining that reviewer edits are ALLOWED in all states except Approved (rejected+awaiting+draft are all editable for MPCA).

MPCA-141 notifications target role_id='secretary' + 'president' with body_id = squad.body_id. For a DIV-IND squad this notifies role_id='secretary' at DIV-IND — but the actual Division Secretary persona uses role_id='division-secretary'. Verify with product whether these notifications are intended for MPCA-side visibility only or should also fan out to 'division-secretary' when body is a Division/District. (Not blocking Iteration A, but flagging.)
test_credentials: persona-chip-secretary (MPCA) used for MPCA flows. Backend tests use raw X-Role-Id/X-User-Body-Code headers.
seed_data_creation: Reused existing squad 93a7fa22-9c1f-4740-b1e6-9feb331046d1 (DIV-IND, Madhavrao Scindia Trophy). Left in Draft state post-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration B will bring age filter (MPCA-136/137), per-player approve/reject (MPCA-140), PDF export overhaul (MPCA-127/142). The DIV-IND squad on Madhavrao Scindia Trophy is now built out with 11 players + captain (TEST_M35 Player One) and can be submitted/approved on demand. Backend Notification model now accepts kind='squad_review' + severity='success'.
rca of the issue: MPCA-141 initial implementation failed silently because Notification Pydantic model's kind and severity Literals were narrower than the values passed by review_squad_by_mpca. The enclosing try/except pass in the handler suppressed the ValidationError, so approve/reject worked but zero notifications reached the DB. Reproduction: POST /api/squads/{sid}/review with action=approve → response 200 → GET /api/notifications?recipient_role_id=secretary&recipient_body_id={body_id} returns nothing. Fix: widen the Literals in models.py.
